chunks: Their apostles said to them: "Indeed we are men like you, but God bestows His favours on whomsoever He wills among His creatures. It is not in our power to bring a miracle for you without the leave of God. The believers should only place their trust in God."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of prophets being human in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the 'humanity of the prophets' (al-Bashariyyah), affirming that while they are chosen servants, their authority and miracles are contingent upon divine permission rather than inherent divinity. It serves as a refutation of those who deified their leaders, urging believers to direct their ultimate reliance (Tawakkul) to Allah alone, who bestows favor upon whom He wills.
